critique: The cyan-on-black wireframe treatment and expanding motion are on target, and the later frame has a more substantial scale than the previous iteration. However, both frames still read as a dense central ball of intersecting outlines rather than a deliberate field of individually legible wireframe pyramids. The high simultaneous particle count obscures pyramid silhouettes, especially at t4, where overlap becomes heavier instead of creating a spacious geometric spread.

suggestions.why: Lower the emission rate substantially so fewer pyramids occupy the same region and individual silhouettes remain readable.
Shorten particle lifetime to prevent accumulated old pyramids from rebuilding the dense central knot.
Increase outward velocity so the reduced number of pyramids separates into a broader abstract field rather than remaining concentrated at the emitter.
